Title: Create a payment with a new idempotency key
Steps:
1. Generate a key
2. POST /payments
3. Query provider captures

Title: Replay a completed payment request
Steps: 1. Repeat the original request with the same key
Expected Result: Original response is returned; no duplicate capture

Title: Fail over when the primary provider times out
Steps:
1. Enable timeout
2. Create payment
3. Inspect audit trail
Expected Result: Secondary provider succeeds; both attempts are recorded

Title: Rotate a refresh token after use
Expected Result: New token works; old token is rejected

Title: Complete account recovery with keyboard navigation
Steps:
1. Start recovery
2. Complete all fields using keyboard only
Expected Result: Recovery succeeds; focus is visible and ordered

Title: Split order across eligible warehouses
Expected Result: Allocations use the fewest eligible warehouses

Title: Recalculate tax after a partial cancellation
Steps:
1. Cancel one line
2. Read totals and tax events
Expected Result: Totals match remaining lines and tax rules

Title: Retain routing history after warehouse change
Steps:
1. Query order events
2. Compare timestamps and actors
Expected Result: Original and replacement routes remain immutable
